OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER
FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.6 (22 Sep 45) AG-KD
(SCAPIN - 46)
APO 500
22 September 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR THE JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Report on Filipino Prisoners of War.
1． The Philippine Government advises many Filipinos were taken as prisoners of war or civilian internees by the Japanese Government during the period of occupation of the Philippine Islands by the Japanese Forces.
2． It is desired that this headquarters be informed in writing at once regarding the following:
a. The total number of Filipinos removed from the Philippines.
b. The date of each movement, the number removed, and the destination.
c. The names, rank, serial number of all the above.
d. The Location of each camp where such Filipinos were taken.
e. The present location, status and physical condition of these Filipinos.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ Harold Fair.
/t/ HAROLD FAIR,
Lt. Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General.
